title: Functorial factorization
statement: The stated intermediate equality for the coefficient transition.

proof.text: Apply CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp to the homology functor and the two composable morphisms. No endpoint coherence or coefficient identification is needed.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q8 and 09Z1; B2 applies CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp directly to the homology functor.
